profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Consultant with 15 years of experience implementing Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and Case Management solutions across many industries in both the public and private sectors including Healthcare, Education, Public Housing, and Insurance.  Performed both technical and functional roles.  Skilled in:
 - Requirement analysis
 - Process re-engineering 
 - Facilitating Joint Application Development (JAD) sessions to elicit requirements from stakeholders and end users
 - Development (Siebel development, report development, data migration, and system integration development). 

 Implemented solutions using both the System Development Lifecycle and the Agile Methodology.
